rulings.answer: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 1 or further to the left on your side.
rulings.question: What position on the memory gauge does "if you have 1 or more memory" refer to?

rulings.answer: This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating.  Triggered [When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate when a card digivolves or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.
rulings.question: What does "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects" mean, exactly?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  The effect can activate if it's triggered upon the [When Attacking] timing.
rulings.question: I used a card affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack.  Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?

If a card is affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects," can it activate its own [When Digivolving] effect using an effect such as "activate 1 of that card's [When Digivolving] effects"?

If a card is affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects," can another card's [When Digivolving] effect be activated using an effect such as "activate 1 of that card's [When Digivolving] effects as an effect of this card"?

Can I use "activate 1 of that card's [When Digivolving] effects as an effect of this card" on a card that isn't affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects" to activate the [When Digivolving] effect on another card that's affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects"?
If a card is affected by "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by doing X" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?

rulings.answer: No, it doesn't count.  The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].
rulings.question: A card digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect while "can't [...] activate [When Digivolving] effects" was activated.  Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
